description: TASK-15 預設批改模型評測題組：40 句台灣學習者常見錯句（中翻英 30、造句 10）。answer＝學習者寫的錯句；mustFix＝必修錯誤點，批改後的句子不得再含 wrong、且須含 fix 任一寫法（不分大小寫）。

items.promptZh: 我有一個蘋果。
referenceEn: I have an apple.
rubricZh: 母音開頭的字前面用 an
items.answer: I have a apple.

items.errorType: 主詞動詞一致（第三人稱單數）
items.promptZh: 她每天早上喝咖啡。
referenceEn: She drinks coffee every morning.
rubricZh: 第三人稱單數現在式動詞加 s
items.answer: She drink coffee every morning.

items.promptZh: 桌上有一本書。
referenceEn: There is a book on the table.
rubricZh: 表示「某處有某物」用 there is／there are，不用 there has
items.answer: There has a book on the table.

items.errorType: 副詞位置（very 修飾動詞）
items.promptZh: 我非常喜歡音樂。
referenceEn: I really like music.
I like music very much.
rubricZh: very 不能直接修飾動詞，用 really like 或 like … very much
items.answer: I very like music.

items.promptZh: 昨天我去了圖書館。
referenceEn: Yesterday I went to the library.
I went to the library yesterday.
rubricZh: yesterday 表示過去，動詞用過去式 went
items.answer: Yesterday I go to the library.

items.promptZh: 他不知道她住在哪裡。
referenceEn: He doesn't know where she lives.
rubricZh: 間接問句用直述句語序，不用 does 倒裝
items.answer: He doesn't know where does she live.

items.promptZh: 雖然下雨，我們還是去了公園。
referenceEn: Although it was raining, we still went to the park.
rubricZh: although 和 but 不能在同一句一起用
items.answer: Although it was raining, but we still went to the park.

items.errorType: 時間介系詞（星期用 on）
items.promptZh: 我們星期一有考試。
referenceEn: We have a test on Monday.
rubricZh: 星期幾前面用 on
items.answer: We have a test in Monday.

items.promptZh: 老師給了我們很多建議。
referenceEn: The teacher gave us a lot of advice.
rubricZh: advice 不可數，不加 s；many 改 a lot of 或 much
items.answer: The teacher gave us many advices.

items.promptZh: 我很期待見到你。
referenceEn: I am looking forward to meeting you.
I look forward to seeing you.
rubricZh: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接動名詞
items.answer: I am looking forward to meet you.

items.errorType: 及物動詞多加介系詞（discuss about）
items.promptZh: 我們明天要討論這個問題。
referenceEn: We will discuss this problem tomorrow.
rubricZh: discuss 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞，不加 about
items.answer: We will discuss about this problem tomorrow.

items.promptZh: 看這部電影的時候，我覺得很無聊。
referenceEn: I felt very bored during the movie.
I was very bored during the movie.
rubricZh: 描述人的感受用 bored；boring 是形容事物讓人無聊
items.answer: I was very boring during the movie.

items.errorType: 現在完成式（持續到現在）
items.promptZh: 我住在台北已經五年了。
referenceEn: I have lived in Taipei for five years.
I've been living in Taipei for five years.
rubricZh: 從過去持續到現在的狀態用現在完成式（have lived）
items.answer: I live in Taipei for five years.

items.promptZh: 她的英文比我的好多了。
referenceEn: Her English is much better than mine.
rubricZh: better 已經是比較級，不再加 more；加強用 much
items.answer: Her English is more better than mine.

items.promptZh: 我昨天沒有去上班。
referenceEn: I didn't go to work yesterday.
rubricZh: didn't 後面接原形動詞
items.answer: I didn't went to work yesterday.

items.promptZh: 他建議我早點睡。
referenceEn: He suggested that I go to bed earlier.
He suggested I sleep earlier.
rubricZh: suggest 不接「人＋to 不定詞」，用 suggest (that) 子句
items.answer: He suggested me to sleep earlier.

items.promptZh: 請打開燈。
referenceEn: Please turn on the light.
rubricZh: 開燈用 turn on／switch on，不用 open
items.answer: Please open the light.

items.promptZh: 這件事是什麼時候發生的？
referenceEn: When did it happen?
When did this happen?
rubricZh: happen 是不及物動詞，沒有被動式
items.answer: When was it happened?

items.errorType: be 動詞＋一般動詞（am agree）
items.promptZh: 我同意你的看法。
referenceEn: I agree with you.
rubricZh: agree 是動詞，前面不加 am
items.answer: I am agree with you.

items.promptZh: 我花了很多錢買這支手機。
referenceEn: I spent a lot of money on this phone.
I spent a lot of money buying this phone.
rubricZh: spend 金錢 on 東西，或 spend 金錢＋動名詞
items.answer: I spent a lot of money to buy this phone.

items.promptZh: 她嫁給了一位醫生。
referenceEn: She married a doctor.
She got married to a doctor.
rubricZh: marry 直接接人，不加 with；或用 get married to
items.answer: She married with a doctor.

items.promptZh: 這裡的人都很友善。
referenceEn: The people here are very friendly.
rubricZh: people 是複數名詞，動詞用 are
items.answer: The people here is very friendly.

items.promptZh: 他讓我等了一個小時。
referenceEn: He made me wait for an hour.
He kept me waiting for an hour.
rubricZh: make 人 做某事：make＋受詞＋原形動詞，不加 to
items.answer: He made me to wait for an hour.

items.promptZh: 你可以解釋這個字給我聽嗎？
referenceEn: Can you explain this word to me?
rubricZh: explain 東西 to 人，不說 explain 人 東西
items.answer: Can you explain me this word?

items.promptZh: 我已經吃過早餐了。
referenceEn: I have already eaten breakfast.
I've already had breakfast.
rubricZh: 已經完成的事用現在完成式（have already eaten）
items.answer: I already eat breakfast.

items.promptZh: 我們有很多作業要寫。
referenceEn: We have a lot of homework to do.
rubricZh: homework 不可數，不加 s
items.answer: We have a lot of homeworks to do.

items.promptZh: 因為下雨，所以比賽取消了。
referenceEn: Because it rained, the game was cancelled.
The game was canceled because it rained.
rubricZh: because 和 so 不能在同一句一起用
items.answer: Because it rained, so the game was cancelled.

items.promptZh: 儘管很累，她還是完成了工作。
referenceEn: Despite being tired, she finished the work.
Despite feeling tired, she finished her work.
rubricZh: despite 是介系詞，後面接名詞或動名詞，不接完整子句
items.answer: Despite she was tired, she finished the work.

fix: Despite the fact that she was

items.errorType: 現在完成式配過去時間
items.promptZh: 他上個月去了日本。
referenceEn: He went to Japan last month.
rubricZh: 有明確過去時間（last month）用過去式，不用現在完成式
items.answer: He has gone to Japan last month.

items.errorType: can 與 able to 並用
items.promptZh: 我沒辦法參加明天的會議。
referenceEn: I can't attend tomorrow's meeting.
I won't be able to attend tomorrow's meeting.
rubricZh: can 和 be able to 意思相同，不能疊在一起用
items.answer: I can't able to attend tomorrow's meeting.

items.promptZh: 用 an 或 a 造一個句子，說說你有的一樣東西。
referenceEn: I have a pen.
rubricZh: 子音開頭的字前面用 a，母音開頭用 an
items.answer: I have an pen.

items.promptZh: 用 yesterday 造一個句子，說說你昨天做的一件事。
referenceEn: Yesterday I watched a movie with my friends.
rubricZh: yesterday 表示過去，動詞用過去式
items.answer: Yesterday I watch a movie with my friends.

items.promptZh: 用 enjoy 造一個句子，說說你喜歡的活動。
referenceEn: I enjoy swimming in the summer.
rubricZh: enjoy 後面接動名詞，不接 to 不定詞
items.answer: I enjoy to swim in the summer.

items.promptZh: 用 whether 造一個句子，說說你還沒決定的一件事。
referenceEn: I am not sure whether I should call him.
I am not sure whether to call him.
rubricZh: whether 子句用直述句語序（主詞在前）
items.answer: I am not sure whether should I call him.

items.promptZh: 用 since 造一個句子，說說你從什麼時候開始做某件事。
referenceEn: I have studied English since 2020.
rubricZh: since 表示「自從…到現在」，主要子句用現在完成式
items.answer: I study English since 2020.

items.promptZh: 用 information 造一個句子。
referenceEn: Can you give me some information about the tour?
rubricZh: information 不可數，不加 s
items.answer: Can you give me some informations about the tour?

items.promptZh: 用 afraid 造一個句子，說說你害怕的事。
referenceEn: I am afraid of speaking English in public.
rubricZh: 介系詞 of 後面接動名詞
items.answer: I am afraid of speak English in public.

items.promptZh: 用 listen 造一個句子，說說你晚上常做的事。
referenceEn: I like to listen to music at night.
rubricZh: listen 後面要接 to 再接受詞
items.answer: I like to listen music at night.

items.promptZh: 用 used to 造一個句子，說說你以前的習慣。
referenceEn: I used to play basketball after school.
rubricZh: 表示過去習慣的 used to 後面接原形動詞
items.answer: I used to playing basketball after school.

items.promptZh: 用 unless 造一個句子，提醒別人一件事。
referenceEn: Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
rubricZh: unless 已經是「除非／如果不」，子句裡不再加 don't
items.answer: Unless you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
